summary.intent: Coordinate a wave of parallel subagents making repo changes (bug fixes, exit_kind, deletions, an AGENTS.md section, and removal of the note_once global) and review their results.
summary.outcome: The note_once removal agent stopped without changes because the duplicate note stems from duplicate workspace loads. The AGENTS.md agent added an 'Enforcing an invariant' section on branch docs/invariant-ladder, pushed and signed, and the assistant began reviewing its diff.

repo: note_once fires twice because the workspace is loaded twice: init loads it in detect and again in preview; release loads in load_workspace and again in validate_release_intent.
The note is emitted from the locator walk, so every extra workspace load repeats it; there is no single once-per-command place to print from.
Repo uses just recipes (just doc-check, just pre-push, just lint, just test), signed commits, and changesets/PRs as separate steps.

code.finding: init loads the workspace in both detect and preview, causing a duplicate load and a repeated note.
validate_release_intent reloads the workspace after load_workspace already loaded it; unclear whether the reload is intentional (e.g. to see fresh state after a write).

workflow: Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user authority; verify their claims by inspecting the diff (git fetch plus git diff origin/main...origin/branch) before accepting.
Agent stop conditions (e.g. a signature change spanning multiple paths) are useful to avoid oversized refactors.
Subagents leave stray local branches in worktrees that need cleanup.

friction: The note_once agent hit its stop condition: removing the global requires a signature change across init, release and capability paths.
The AGENTS.md agent did not run just lint, just test or the GitHub verification-reason check, so verification is partial.
open_items: Decide whether to queue a duplicate-workspace-load investigation after wave 1 (pass the loaded workspace into validate_release_intent and preview); awaiting user input.
Check whether the second workspace load in the release path is intentional (fresh state after a write).
Delete the unused local branch refactor/note-without-global in the agent's worktree.
Finish reviewing the docs/invariant-ladder diff; no PR or changeset has been created for it.
Other wave 1 agents (bug fixes, exit_kind, deletions) were still running.
